mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_records (product_id, operation_type, quantity, before_stock, after_stock, reason, operator_id, operated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{operationType}, #{quantity}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{operatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, operation_type, quantity, before_stock, after_stock, reason, operator_id, operated_at FROM inventory_records ORDER BY operated_at DESC
